title: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1988
verified_how: Fetched a Wayback copy of the India Code PDF bitstream/123456789/15390/1/the_motor_vehicles_act,_1988.pdf. It shows 'THE MOTOR VEHICLES ACT, 1988' and 'ACT NO. 59 OF 1988', a current consolidated text including ss.2A and 2B added in 2019.
notes: Compulsory third-party motor insurance and compensation claims before Motor Accidents Claims Tribunals (Chapters XI–XII).
